1.explanation:
1. We define a DataTable with three columns: ID, Protocol, and Actions.  
2. In the Actions cell, we render a small OverflowMenu (using the vertical icon) with three MenuItems.  
3. Build and run this component, then use keyboard only: Tab into a row’s OverflowMenu trigger, press Enter or Space to open the menu, and use the Up/Down arrow keys.  
4. You will observe that the menu items receive keyboard focus (they can be selected via Enter), but no focus ring or highlight appears on the active item inside the table context.  
5. This reproduces the a11y bug described in the report: lack of visual focus styles for OverflowMenuItem when used inside a DataTable.
1.bug_scenario: We have a DataTable with an extra “Actions” column that renders a small OverflowMenu in each row. When you open the menu via keyboard (Enter or Space), you can see the menu items, but pressing the arrow keys moves the invisible focus — there is no visual indicator around the active menu item. In contrast, a standalone OverflowMenu (outside a table) shows a clear focus ring on whichever item is active. This makes keyboard-only selection inside a DataTable’s OverflowMenu unusable.
